title: The tag resolves to exactly one node that carries no bounds at all
why: Uniqueness is necessary and not sufficient: without usable bounds there is nothing to measure a displacement *from*, so the element cannot be shown to have stayed put and the acceptance must not keep suppressing its pixels. Zero-area is included because it is the shape a projector emits for a node it laid out but never placed — structurally a box, measurably nothing.
